F_t.action: type [99] [kkroening/ffmpeg-python] [1] in the navbar search box
F_t.cause: The navbar search box triggered a global search page instead of navigating directly to the repository. The search returned 0 projects matching 'kkroening/ffmpeg-python'.
The search box already contained 'kkroening/ffmpeg-python', so typing 'ffmpeg-python' appended to it, creating the invalid query 'kkroening/ffmpeg-pythonffmpeg-python' which returned 0 results.
The search box already contained 'kkroening/ffmpeg-pythonffmpeg-python', so typing again appended to create 'kkroening/ffmpeg-pythonffmpeg-pythonkkroening/ffmpeg-python', returning 0 results.
The click on the Clear button did not clear the search box before the page reloaded; the URL still shows the old concatenated search term, and the search box still shows the full concatenated string.
The type action cleared the search box content (as the searchbox showed focused with no text in DOM), but the page did not reload with new results - the URL still showed the old search term.

F_t.action: type [14745] [label:question] [1] in the issues filter textbox
F_t.cause: The type action only partially entered the text - the search box received only 'tion' (the last 4 characters of 'label:question'), and the page navigated to the global search with query 'tion' scoped to issues in ffmpeg-python project, finding 0 issues. The label filter was not applied correctly.

The agent clicked the Clear button but the page remained on the search results page showing 'tion' query with 0 issues. The agent is now on the wrong page (global search) instead of the issues list page with label filter.
